decisions.reason: Terminologia Neuroanatomica review: defines telencephalon medium (T) as the part rostral to D1 in the prosomeric scheme; needed to locate the paraphysis territory in current terminology (terminology question), though paraphysis itself is not named in the excerpt.
In vitro mESC model of BMP4 specification of cortical hem vs choroid plexus fate; never relates to the paraphysis region, not necessary to interpret it.
Opsin gene loss and parietal eye loss in archelosaurs; pineal-complex photoreception, no paraphysis content.
Official TNA nomenclature, metadata only; unknown whether it lists a paraphysis/telencephalon impar entry. Resolve by searching the TNA/FIPAT term list for paraphysis and its parent unit.

Radiopaedia entry titled 'Paraphysis elements': describes the embryonic paraphysis as a strand between telencephalon and diencephalon and as the believed precursor of third-ventricle colloid cysts (non-peer-reviewed secondary source).
Zebrafish enhancer-trap lines for pineal, parapineal, SCO and choroid plexus CVOs; paraphysis not mentioned.
Nomina Embryologica Veterinaria, metadata only; embryological nomenclature could list paraphysis/telencephalon impar. Resolve by searching the NEV PDF text for 'paraphysis'.
Generic multi-volume reference work (Evolution of Nervous Systems), metadata only; no chapter on the paraphysis or forebrain roof located, edition unclear.
Review of development of seven CVOs (AP, ME, NH, OVLT, pineal, SCO, SFO); paraphysis not among them and no comparison with it.
General review of brain ventricular system development and choroid plexus; no paraphysis link.

Frog brain anatomy paper describing the paraphysis cerebri (glandular organ at the third ventricle) and comparing its size/shape across anuran species (larger in climber-walkers, cord-like in hopper-walker): original comparative gross-anatomy data.

Colloid cyst case report; only a single passing sentence that origin is postulated from paraphysis, ependyma or choroid plexus (web summary, unverified); no documentation or evaluation of paraphyseal origin.
Clinical series of congenital foramen of Monro occlusion with a tentative embryological pathogenesis; no paraphysis or colloid-cyst histogenesis data.
Review of ancestral vertebrate brain; excerpt concerns lamprey epiphysis/pineal homology, not the paraphysis.
Nomina Anatomica Veterinaria (domestic mammals), metadata only; no paraphysis entry confirmed and adult domestic mammals lack a paraphysis.
Fatal haemorrhagic colloid cyst case report; asserts neuroepithelial origin only, no paraphysis data.

Radiological review of Rathke cyst, craniopharyngioma and colloid cyst; only a generic ecto/endodermal boundary argument, no paraphysis or colloid-cyst histogenesis specific enough to weigh the paraphyseal hypothesis.
3D MRI atlas of a lizard brain; full abstract does not mention paraphysis, telencephalon impar or roof structures.

Case of paired colloid cysts titled 'a discussion of embryological origin'; unclear whether paraphyseal origin is argued. Resolve by reading the open-access full text (clinmedjournals ijbdt-4-023) for the paraphysis/endoderm discussion.

Xenopus vascular-corrosion-cast study reporting that the choroidal artery supplies the paraphysis and third-ventricle choroid plexus (with venous drainage): original data on paraphysis vascularisation.
McCune-Albright syndrome case with incidental colloid cyst material; no paraphysis or histogenesis discussion.
Systematic review of natural history/progression of incidental colloid cysts; clinical correlate only.
Systematic review of glioependymal cysts (neuroectodermal origin, terminology confusion); no paraphysis link.
Fossil lizard with pineal and parapineal eyes and pineal-complex bauplan; paraphysis not part of the abstract.
Interhemispheric connectivity in monotremes/marsupials via anterior commissure; no paraphysis content.
Illustrated companion book to the TNA focused on human neuroanatomy, metadata only; no evidence of a paraphysis entry.
NIMHANS histological series of 538 non-neoplastic CNS cysts (126 colloid cysts); descriptive frequencies only, no histogenesis or paraphysis data.
Mouse Lmx1a/Lmx1b study of dorsal-midline Bmp/Wnt output and neocortical gyrification; does not relate to the paraphysis region.
Zebrafish enhancer-trap review of CVO origin (roof plate, low Wnt); abstract does not name paraphysis or dorsal sac.
Pax6 distribution map in adult lungfish pallium/subpallium etc.; full abstract mentions no paraphysis, dorsal sac or roof structures.
Human fetal hippocampal fissure and Cajal-Retzius cells; caudal hem and choroid plexus context only, no paraphysis link.
Prevalence of cavum veli interpositi cysts in fetal ultrasound; no bearing on paraphysis.
Molecular pathways of corpus callosum formation; lamina reuniens only incidental, no paraphysis relevance.

Manganese-enhanced MRI in frogs reporting the greatest signal change in torus semicircularis, habenula and the paraphysis after conspecific calls: original experimental functional data on the paraphysis (not the study focus).
Editorial on TNA and prosomeric terminology; metadata only, no paraphysis content known.
Suprasellar colloid cyst case; only a generic statement of endodermal derivation and unclear development, no paraphysis discussion.
General anatomy textbook (Sobotta), metadata only; cited only for a 'Telencephalon impar' dictionary entry, no known paraphysis statement.
Skink telencephalon cytoarchitecture; abstract only lists 'telencephalon medium or impar' as a component and describes cortex and olfactory bulb; no paraphysis data.
Familial colloid cysts case report and tabulation; genetic hypothesis only, no paraphysis.
Hindbrain choroid plexus specification by Zfp423; no relation to the telencephalic roof or paraphysis.
Spontaneous colloid cyst regression case; introduction merely states cysts are 'thought to be derived from the paraphysis' without evidence or evaluation.
Imaging-histopathology series of colloid cysts for obstruction risk; no embryological or paraphysis content.
Colloid cysts in monozygotic twins, genetic etiology discussion; no paraphysis.
Review of fatal colloid cyst cases; clinical correlates only.
Spanish case report of endoscopy-assisted colloid cyst excision; only 'probably derived from the endoderm', no paraphysis mention in full abstract.
Ultrasound study of normal cavum veli interpositi at 14-17 weeks (tela choroidea fluid space); does not locate or bear on the paraphysis.
